attributes.name: Skull Ripper
attributes.powers:
The Skull Ripper is immune to the Attack and Mental traits.

If undefeated, succeed at a Dexterity or Acrobatics 7 check or when you are dealt damage, discard cards from the top of your deck instead of your hand; this damage may not be reduced.

corrections.corrected_text: On the monster Skull Ripper, add the power "The Skull Ripper is immune to the Attack and Mental traits."
corrections.issue: The Skull Ripper is a Construct. Should it be affected by spells that have the Mental trait?
